did: Arrived from a Google ad; 18th-anniversary hero, deal of the day, eight category tiles, brand row.
works: Search, departments menu and a strong deal (iMac -22%) visible without scrolling.
friction: The ad opens the homepage, not the product searched for; category tiles move between visits; 'PC GAMING Beyond pergormance.' banner.
benchmark: Send each ad to the page that matches the search.

did: Typed a GPU model into the header search.
works: Instant results with images, prices and discounts, a 'PC Gaming > NVIDIA RTX' suggestion and 'view all (100+)'.
friction: 'Recent searches' showed someone else's quote request: 'Please For Pc , Qty 2: DELL PC PRO QVT1260 …'.
benchmark: Baymard: only 19% of sites get autocomplete fully right. Golden Tech is ahead here.

did: Opened PC Gaming, sorted by price.
works: A 'What are you looking for?' finder (Processor, Memory, Storage, Graphic Card), nine filters, sort by price, four spec lines per card.
friction: Most builds use the same case image; long titles repeat the spec lines; black Add to Cart here, gold on the homepage.
benchmark: Baymard: 69% of sites miss a key sort option and 51% lack essential filters. Golden Tech is ahead.

did: Opened the RTX 3050 build (4,699 SAR, was 6,599).
works: Clear title and price, 24-month Golden Tech warranty, Tamara/Tabby 4 × 1,174.75, a 14-row spec table, sticky Add to Cart bar.
friction: 'Delivery in Riyadh: 24 hours' contradicts the Terms; no delivery cost or date; 'There are no ratings.'; three instalment boxes and two promos crowd the buy box; navy Buy Now outweighs gold Add to Cart; one rendered image.
benchmark: Baymard: 67% of product pages show no estimated total near the buy button; 41% show speed, not a date.

did: Added the PC to the cart.
works: Free-shipping progress bar ('You've earned free shipping!'), Order Total 4,699, gold Checkout button.
friction: Subtotal 4,086 (before VAT) sits next to a 4,699 item; 'Total Savings -1,900' looks like a deduction; quantity needs 'Update Shopping Cart'; '4699.00' formatting.
benchmark: Baymard: 12% abandon when they can't see the total upfront; 40% over unexpected extra costs.

did: Typed email, address and mobile number.
works: Guest checkout ('You can create an account after checkout'), map location picker, store pickup option, building number and postal code.
friction: Red 'Please verify your phone number first.' before any action; the dark 'Send Otp' button looks disabled, so the auditor couldn't tell if it was active; no Short Address field.
benchmark: Baymard: average checkout has 23.48 form elements, ideal 12–14. Carriers must reject parcels without a valid National Address since Jan 2026.

did: Reviewed payment options and the order summary.
works: mada and cards, Tabby, Tamara and card instalments; discount-code field; order summary.
friction: Tabby and Tamara both read 'Pay 4 interest-free payments'; cash on delivery advertised but not offered; no Apple Pay in Chrome; 'Place Order' in a blue used nowhere else.
benchmark: Baymard: 9% abandon for too few payment methods.

works: Simple email and password with show-password toggle and 'Forgot Your Password?'.
friction: Checkout identifies shoppers by phone, sign-in by email; gold 'Create an account' link is faint; FAQ still says an account is required.
benchmark: Baymard: forced account creation causes 18% of abandonments. Golden Tech doesn't force it but says it does.

did: Read delivery, returns, refund and warranty terms.
works: Two-year warranty, complaints link, CR and VAT numbers in the footer.
friction: Delivery fee and time contradict the cart and product page; 7-day defects-only returns; refunds 1–5 vs 3–30 days; no WhatsApp.
benchmark: Baymard: 13% abandon over the returns policy. eXtra allows 14 days online; Amazon.sa and noon 15 days.
